Measurement.description:
Holds a single measurement for either a sensor or valve.

This enum simply wraps two other types, `SensorMeasurement` and
`ValveMeasurement`. The reason to keep this in separate structs instead of
properties of the variants is that these values often need to passed around
independently in flight code, and enum variant properties are not mutable
without reconstructing the variant. This is annoying. Essentially, this
looks like bad / less readable code but is necessary, and convenience
constructs are provided to make code cleaner.

unit.description: The unit associated with the measurement.

value.description: The raw value associated with the measurement.

MeasurementNoiseMatrix.description: Measurement noise matrix sent to RECO for EKF updates.

NodeMapping.description: The mapping of an individual node.

board_id.description:
A string identifying an individual board, corresponding to the hostname
sans ".local".

calibrated_offset.description:
The calibrated offset of the sensor.
This is only used for sensors with channel type PT.

channel.description: A number identifying which channel on the SAM board controls the node.

computer.description: Which computer controls the SAM board, "flight" or "ground".

max.description:
The maximum value reading of the sensor.
This is only used for sensors with channel type CurrentLoop or
DifferentialSignal.

min.description:
The minimum value reading of the sensor.
This is only used for sensors with channel type CurrentLoop or
DifferentialSignal.

normally_closed.description: Indicator of whether the valve is normally open or normally closed.

powered_threshold.description: The threshold, in Amps, at which the valve is considered powered.

sensor_type.description: The channel type of the node, such as "valve".

text_id.description: The text identifier, or name, of the node.

RecoTriState.description:
Three RECO slots as stored in the live vehicle state.

The TEL codec intentionally treats this as a lossy aggregate: all present
entries are averaged into a single on-wire sample, and the decoded sample is
then duplicated back into all three slots.

Whether the current `reco` samples are fresh for this control-loop

ingests new RECO samples, and set it to `false` immediately after
